neighbours.label: ' high' / ' low' as a quantitative modifier in scientific methods (low concentration, high-dose, high-throughput)
fire: Neurons were imaged after loading them with a low concentration of the calcium dye.
The trial compared high-dose vitamin D with placebo in elderly patients.
Mutant libraries were screened using a high throughput fluorescence assay.
Mice fed a low protein diet showed reduced liver weight after six weeks.
Samples were spun at high speed to pellet the mitochondria before staining.
Plants grown under low light produced thinner leaves than the controls.
Patients received a high intensity statin regimen for twelve months.
The cultures were maintained at low oxygen tension to mimic tumour conditions.
quiet: Neurons were imaged after loading them with a calcium dye for thirty minutes.
The trial compared vitamin D tablets with placebo in elderly patients.
Mutant libraries were screened using a fluorescence assay in plates.
Our shop sells high-end kitchen gear and handmade knives.
The kite flew high over the beach while the children cheered.
Plants grown in the greenhouse produced thinner leaves than the controls.
Fans paid high prices for tickets to the final concert of the tour.
The cultures were maintained in an incubator to mimic tumour conditions.

notes: Card: - pole peaks ' high' x8, ' low' x3 in lab/clinical text; the + pole also peaks on ' high' but in commercial/everyday compounds (high-value, high-tech). Probe: 'low dose of the inhibitor' 0.50, 'high throughput sequencing' 0.31, everyday high ~0.03.
